variants.name: skill-pack-install-verification
variants.description: Deterministic verification receipt for public skill-pack fetch, build, atomic install, and UAR inventory

notes: The public HTTPS endpoint served the exact UAR-pinned commit.
A real locked release build produced prometheus-cli 1.7.0 and installed 311 manifests.
Wrong-commit and failed-build controls refused activation.
A clean-prefix server-full test exposed the exact 147-skill default loader inventory through the skills API with built-in origin.
Independent artifact critic and judge accepted the corrected candidate.
